response.rationale: A and B overlap, but they don't describe the same capability. A ("Ticket sales, online payment and refunds", community:1) covers bookings through BookingRepository (node 2e3c5728fffb0180, fan-in 10) as well as payments through PuckPayClient (node 8ce0b3f14177346a). B ("Online payment and refunds", component:persistence) is supported only by PuckPayClient. So B looks like the payment part of A, not the whole thing: A also includes ticket sales and booking. Because B is a strict subset of A rather than an equal, I judge them different, with moderate confidence.
